title: AC1021 TABLE border lineweight and visibility DXF mapping
scope: Bounded codec mapping for the three title/header/data border lineweight and visibility arrays retained from AC1021 TABLE DWG data.

oda_specification.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
findings: Lineweight and visibility each use 18 slots in three groups of six: title, header, data.
Within each group the category order is horizontal top, horizontal inside, horizontal bottom, vertical left, vertical inside, vertical right.
DWG visibility uses 0 for visible and 1 for invisible; lineweight is stored as a 16-bit field.
TABLE entity groups 274-279 describe border lineweights by cell type; groups 284-289 describe visibility by cell type.
DXF visibility uses 0 for invisible and 1 for visible.
Border color groups 65, 66, 68 and 69 are shared border categories, not a set of 18 row-specific values.
autodesk_dxf_reference.limit: The reference does not state repeat order or prove native edge precedence.

independent_implementation_cross_check.finding: Its TABLESTYLE writer emits six border categories in top, horizontal-inside, bottom, left, vertical-inside, right order using consecutive groups 274-279 and 284-289.
independent_implementation_cross_check.limit: This is an independent serializer cross-check, not a physical producer sample or native semantic witness.

behavior: Maps slot n to group 274+(n mod 6) for lineweight and 284+(n mod 6) for visibility, preserving title/header/data selection order.
Transports lineweight as an exact 16-bit bit pattern through signed DXF I16 values.
Inverts visibility at the DWG/DXF boundary.
Separates row-level values from cell-level border groups and counts selected occurrences per category.
Marks missing or excess selected values semantically incomplete; rejects mask bits outside the 18-slot domain.
Refuses orphaned values, absent selected-presence markers, invalid visibility values, and unsupported per-row border CMC output atomically.

validation.fixture_policy: No external DWG/DXF fixture was added; controls were locally authored in existing test code.
tests: libdxfrw_table_row_alignment_override_parse: ASCII/Binary repeated field parsing, all six category groups, signed 16-bit lineweight preservation, DWG/DXF visibility inversion, selected values and missing-field incompleteness.

libdxfrw_table_scalar_override_output: ASCII/Binary exact group sequence, distinct cell and entity-level values sharing group codes, parseback, selected zero, invalid-visibility and orphan/mask atomic refusals, destination preservation and corrected retry.
validation.result: Focused build succeeded. All three CTests passed after correcting the retry control to restore its valid mapped border profile.

qualification_limits: No physical AutoCAD/ODA-produced TABLE DXF witness establishes producer ordering across versions.
No native application check establishes cell-vs-row precedence or visible rendering.
Per-row border CMC remains unsupported and output-refused.
The change proves codec mapping only; it does not promote whole-drawing or native TABLE support claims.
